hook.text: A school measured success by test scores. Teachers started teaching only what was on the test.

buildup.text: Goodhart's Law states: when a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure.

discovery.text: Soviet factories measured output by weight. They made chandeliers so heavy they pulled ceilings down.

twist.text: You cannot manage without metrics. But you also cannot trust any single metric.

climax.text: Use multiple metrics that check each other. If one can be gamed, the others should expose the gaming. Triangulate truth.

punchline.text: One metric gets gamed. Use several to triangulate reality.

quiz.question: What happens when a metric becomes a target?
options: People optimize the metric itself rather than the underlying goal
